subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Apropos of nothing

options.text: Almost everything and anything has been included
Having no relevance to any previous discussion or situation

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Apropos of nothing"** is an idiom that means something is said or done without any connection or relevance to the current topic of discussion or situation.(किसी पूर्व चर्चा या स्थिति से संबंध नहीं रखने वाला)
 
• **It implies** a sudden or unexpected statement or action that is unrelated to the context.

The **correct answer** is: *Having no relevance to any previous discussion or situation.*
